entries.title: Nahum 3:1
segments: Woe to the bloody city! It [is] a lie, and full of plunder; the prey is not withdrawn.

entries.title: Nahum 3:2
segments: The sound of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of a wheel, and of a galloping horse, and of a bounding chariot.

entries.title: Nahum 3:3
segments: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the lightning of the spear. And many [are] slain, and [there are] a mass of dead bodies, and no end of corpses; they stumble on their dead bodies,

entries.title: Nahum 3:4
segments: because of the many harlotries of the well-favored harlot, the mistress of sorceries who sells nations by her harlotries, and families by her sorceries.

entries.title: Nahum 3:5
segments: Behold, I [am] against you, says the LORD of hosts; and I will uncover your skirts upon your face. And I will cause the nations to see your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

entries.title: Nahum 3:6
segments: And I will cast filth upon you, and will dishonor you, and will set you as a gazing-stock.

entries.title: Nahum 3:7
segments: And it shall be that all those who look upon you shall flee from you, and say, Nineveh is laid waste; who will weep for her? From where shall I seek comforters for you?

entries.title: Nahum 3:8
segments: Are you better than No Amon, that dwelt among the Nile branches, waters all around her, whose rampart [was] the sea, the waters her wall?

entries.title: Nahum 3:9
segments: Ethiopia and Egypt [were] her strength, yea, without end. Put and Lubim were among your helpers.

entries.title: Nahum 3:10
segments: Yet she [went] into exile; she went into captivity, and her young children also were dashed to pieces at the head of all the streets; and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

entries.title: Nahum 3:11
segments: You also shall be drunken; you shall be hidden, you also shall seek strength because of the enemy.

entries.title: Nahum 3:12
segments: All your strongholds shall be like fig trees with the first fruits; if they are shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

entries.title: Nahum 3:13
segments: Behold, your people in your midst [are] women. The gates of your land shall surely be opened to your enemies; the fire shall devour your bars.

entries.title: Nahum 3:14
segments: Draw waters for the siege; fortify your strongholds; go into the clay, and tread the mortar; make the brick mold strong.

entries.title: Nahum 3:15
segments: There fire shall devour you; the sword shall cut you off, it shall eat you up like the locust. Make yourself as many as the larvae, multiply yourself like the locusts.

entries.title: Nahum 3:16
segments: You have multiplied your merchants above the stars of heaven; the locust larvae shall strip off and fly away.

entries.title: Nahum 3:17
segments: Your rulers [are] like the locusts, and your officials are a swarm of locusts that camp in the hedges in the cold day; the sun rises, and they flee, and the place where they [are] is not known.

entries.title: Nahum 3:18
segments: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria. Your nobles are at rest; your people are scattered upon the mountains, and no one is gathering.

entries.title: Nahum 3:19
segments: There is no healing of your fracture; your wound is grievous; all who hear the news of you shall clap the hands over you; for upon whom has your wickedness not passed continually?
